Retain a broad three-image panel titled 'Packaging formats to discuss' with illustrations of pairbag, shoebox, outercarton, labelled exactly 'Pair bag', 'Shoe box', 'Outer carton', no packing format described as standard, default, available for all products or a guarantee. Delete the whole invented numeric EU36–41 quantity chart, BQ001 label samples, claimed carton dimensions or weight, and tiny four-column paragraphs. Replace middle-lower region with a spacious TWO BY TWO card grid titled 'Order preparation brief': 'Color-size assortment' / 'Style, colors, EU sizes and pairs per size'; 'Pair packaging' / 'Bag or box format and packaging requirements'; 'Labels & artwork' / 'Label text, logo artwork and print placement'; 'Carton plan' / 'Carton quantities, marks and destination'. Each gets a modest practical icon; no fake detailed box text. At bottom one clear process line 'Assortment → Pair packing → Carton list → Shipping quotation', then 'Send your style, quantities and destination for a packing and shipping quotation.' Avoid absolute shipping, DDP, certification, inventory, delivery dates or automatic customization claims. Preserve real warehouse size and rack geometry, no expansion. Enough specific buyer information, more readable text instead of fabricated example tables.
